overview: A Hollywood stunt performer who moonlights as a wheelman for criminals discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

recs.blurb: Ten years after their casino heist, four escaped convicts trace their former partner to a desert town, where he is now a lawman with no memory of his criminal…
Set in Brazil, three kids who make a discovery in a garbage dump soon find themselves running from the cops and trying to right a terrible wrong.
A former U.S. soldier returns to his hometown to find it overrun by crime and corruption, which prompts him to clean house.
Two misunderstood suburban kids challenge society and run from the police while documenting all of their deeds with a digital camera.
A man is out for justice after a group of corrupt police officers are unable to catch his wife's killer.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
An employee of a corporation with a lucrative secret process is tempted to betray it. But there's more to it than that.
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
A gang of criminals and corrupt cops plan the murder of a police officer in order to pull off their biggest heist yet across town.
A thriller that follows two siblings who decide to fend for themselves in the wake of a botched casino heist, and their unlikely reunion during another…
A criminal on the run cons his way into the wrong dinner party where the host is anything but ordinary.
